app.name: Horizon
nav.label: Main
command.label: Command palette
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
home.title: Horizon is running
home.body: This is the skeleton: issues, projects and planning arrive in the next phases. Press {palette} for commands or {help} for shortcuts.
home.check.unreachable: The server did not answer the readiness check.
notFound.title: Page not found
field.name: Name
signIn.title: Sign in
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {email} belongs to an account, a link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Use at least {min} characters. A passphrase of a few words works well.
reset.done: Your password is set. You were signed out everywhere else.
account.title: Account
account.passwordLead: Changing it signs out your other sessions.
account.sessionsLead: Browsers where you are signed in. Sessions end after 30 days without use.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
error.network: Horizon can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match an account.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.version_conflict: Someone changed this in the meantime. The latest version is loaded; try again.
error.email.invalid: Enter an email address such as ada@example.com.
error.current_password.incorrect: This is not your current password.
error.timezone.unknown: Choose a time zone from the list.
error.token.invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid or has expired. Links work once, for one hour.
tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.lead: Personal access tokens let scripts and integrations call the API as you, sent as Authorization: Bearer. They act within your permissions and the scope you choose.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.namePlaceholder: What uses this token, e.g. CI pipeline
tokens.scopeHelp.read: Can read everything you can see, and change nothing.
tokens.scopeHelp.write: Can also create and change issues and everything else you may edit.
tokens.scopeHelp.admin: Can also administer workspaces you manage: members, roles, configuration. Use sparingly.
tokens.copyNow: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
tokens.revokeBody: Anything using “{name}” stops working at once. This can't be undone.
error.too_many_tokens: You have 50 tokens, the most allowed. Revoke unused ones first.
error.expires_at.past: Choose a date in the future.
home.noWorkspace: You're not in a workspace yet
home.noWorkspaceMember: Ask an administrator of your Horizon instance to invite you to a workspace.
home.noWorkspaceAdmin: Create the first workspace: a home for your projects, members and their settings.
home.slugHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It appears in every link to the workspace.
workspace.notFound: This workspace doesn't exist, or you're not a member.
workspace.empty: Projects and issues arrive here next. Meanwhile, invite the people you work with.
settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only workspace administrators can change these settings.
settings.slugHelp: Changing it breaks bookmarks and links shared outside Horizon.
settings.timeZoneHelp: Used for iteration dates and reports, unless a project sets its own.
members.note: Suspending keeps someone's issues and history but blocks their access to this workspace. Removing also takes them out of its teams.
members.suspendBody: They lose access to this workspace until reactivated. Their issues, teams and history stay, and their other workspaces are unaffected.
members.removeBody: They lose access and leave the workspace's teams. Their issues and history stay. They can be invited again.
members.revokeBody: The link in their email stops working.
invite.title: Invite people to {workspace}
invite.help: Each person gets an email with a link valid for 7 days.
teams.deleteBody: Its members stay in the workspace.
teams.name: Name
teams.noneBody: Teams group people so grants and assignments can target them together.
invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.otherAccount: You're signed in as {email}, but this invitation is for {invited}. Sign out, then open the link again.
invitation.signInFirst: You already have an account: sign in to accept.
error.invitation_invalid: This invitation link is invalid, already used, revoked or expired. Ask for a new one.
error.workspace_not_found: This workspace doesn't exist, or you're not a member.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
error.cannot_change_self: You can't do that to yourself.
error.email_mismatch: This invitation is for another email address.
error.member_not_found: That person is no longer a member.
error.insufficient_scope: This token's scope doesn't allow that.
error.session_required: Sign in with a browser to do that.
error.slug.invalid: Use 2–40 lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.
error.name.taken: A team already has this name.
error.time_zone.unknown: Choose a time zone from the list.
error.emails.too_many: Invite at most 50 people at once.
error.team_ids.unknown: One of these teams no longer exists.
